evidence_labels.observed: trace fields, replayed geometry, scalar/native-independent unit differentials, and measured replay timing
evidence_labels.inferred: remaining pending support is reconstructed from the last trace write only when direct local-pipeline-root telemetry is absent
evidence_labels.hypothesized: physical survival or live-authority benefit; neither is claimed by this offline artifact

contract.root: native active action, controller-held desired action, and one pending command with conditioned remaining support; direct trace roots are preferred and cross-checked
contract.write: selected != held samples new delay; selected == held is no-write and preserves the older pending command
contract.scope: finite local lease only; no recursive cadence, future observation maximization, frozen-manager authority, or physical survival claim

sample.method: evenly spaced active/held mismatch roots plus a bounded 240-frame pre-hit supplement
